name: _SlackAdapter
reason: The Chat SDK Slack adapter instance, passed through or used only for its own methods; none of its state is read by these twins.

name: SlackFormatConverter
reason: The SDK formatter instance is only constructed and captured in closures; its state is never read.

name: Blob
reason: The File built for a Pancake upload is only handed to form.set; its contents are never read back.

name: FormData
reason: The upload form is only filled and passed to fetch; its contents are never read back.

name: ^new SlackAdapter$
reason: Vendor SDK constructor; the twin checks the options it is given and returns only closures over it.

name: ^new SlackFormatConverter$
reason: Vendor SDK constructor taking no arguments; only captured in closures.

name: ^slack\.encodeThreadId$
reason: Vendor SDK thread id encoding; the twin only tests whether the id is present.

name: ^new FormData$
reason: Host constructor with no input; the value is only passed on.

name: ^new File$
reason: Host constructor; the twin checks its arguments and only passes the value on.

name: ^form\.set$
reason: Host FormData write whose result is not read.

name: ^fetch$
reason: The Pancake HTTP answer is the outside input; status and body are what the twin decides on.

name: ^response\.text$
reason: Reads the body of the Pancake answer, an outside input.
